svg.title: The plugin system: twenty rows in one file, on a host you can pull a row out of while it runs
svg.desc: A layered picture of the plugin system, in seven numbered parts. One: whatever agent runs the desk, Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, dsh or any command line, calls the brief, report, intraday and strategy-lab commands. Two: one file, strategy-plugins.json, lists every row: thirteen live rows and seven research rows, each an id, a module and its settings. Three: the host mounts every row into a socket; the picture shows all twenty by name, with the research row called bars pulled out of its socket. Four: pulling bars undoes its one registration, the optimizer row that declared it needs bars waits, and the other five rows are not stopped; pushed back in, the optimizer starts by itself. Five: changing a setting, here the adjustment on the daily-bars row from qfq to raw, stops that row, undoes what it registered and starts it again under the new setting. Six: the same five primitives dsh is built on, side by side: a row in a file, a fiber, provide and inject, effect, update. Seven: what has no socket: settlement, the ledger and the risk limits.

text.tspan: Pull a row out. Everything else keeps running.
Twenty rows in one file, mounted on a host built from the primitives dsh runs on.
Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, dsh, any CLI.
Each command reads a row by its name.
02 · ONE FILE SAYS WHAT IS MOUNTED
waiting for a row it declared
Mount order does not matter. A broken row fails alone.
Push it back in: optimizer starts by itself.
A new setting restarts the row
the row stops, and provide(daily_bars) is undone
it starts again, now with adjustment raw
The host reads the file again when it changes.
A change is a restart, never a patch.
Five primitives, the ones dsh is built on
Top line: what dsh calls it. Second line: what it is called here.
Restated in Python, because a row has to run inside this desk’s data and gates.
No row can mark its own call, pick a kinder reference price or keep a result off the record.
